fields.name: generation_id
fields.description: Stable identifier: firm_id, two hyphens, and a slug of generation_label.

fields.name: generation_label
fields.description: Short label of the generation (for example "FF II", "Index VI").

fields.name: vintage
fields.description: Vintage year of the generation's main vehicle.

fields.name: committed_usd_m
fields.description: Committed capital of the generation's in-scope vehicles. Unit: USD m.

fields.name: capital_at_risk_usd_m
fields.description: Sum of capital_at_risk_usd_m over the generation's in-scope vehicles. Unit: USD m.

fields.name: vehicle_roles
fields.description: Roles of the vehicles in the generation, separated by "|".

fields.name: is_growth_generation
fields.description: True if the generation's largest vehicle follows a growth strategy.

fields.name: is_single_company_vehicle
fields.description: True for single-company vehicles (SPVs), which are not ranked.

fields.name: fund_geography
fields.description: Geographic focus used by the attribution rule (US/Global or a country).

fields.name: has_low_confidence_size
fields.description: True if any in-scope vehicle has a low-confidence size.

fields.name: size_confidence
fields.description: Confidence in the size of the main vehicle.

fields.name: n_vehicles
fields.description: Number of vehicles in the generation.

fields.name: rankable
fields.description: True if the generation can enter the fund ranking.

fields.name: not_ranked_reason
fields.description: Why a generation cannot be ranked (single-company vehicle, evergreen or annual pool, cross-generation scheme, firm listed separately, no capital at risk).
